top GND rail @ 29 → bottom GND rail @ 29
holds the relay off if U1 is out of its socket
5 mm leads; reaches pin 14 via the d8→d11 jumper
f2 5V · f3 GND · f4 HB · f5 PERMIT · f6 FB
Wires to K1 relay shield, mounted separately
IN a18 · 5V top +5V rail @ 23 · GND top GND rail @ 25
• Jumper colours: red +5V · black GND · orange HEARTBEAT · blue PERMIT · purple timing · magenta 1Q · green feedback.
• Before inserting U1: power the board and check e9/e16 read 5 V and f9/f16 read 0 V.
